about_the_game:
LIVING HELL is a co-op horror game about surviving in a world consumed by deadly solar radiation.

WORLD IN DECAY

The collapse of the ozone layer was catastrophic. Temperatures soared. Society fell apart.
Governments did what they could — treatments, curfews, military blockades.
But the radiation only worsened, triggering widespread and violent mutations.

SURVIVE THE HEAT

You play as a group of survivors sheltering in Pelican City’s underground subway system.
Venture into the city at night to search for anything that might help you keep cool.
As sunrise nears, the heat builds and the city fills with mutant creatures.

WHO'S GOT YOUR BACK?

Communicate using proximity voice chat and walkie-talkies.
Craft, carry, and manage supplies as a team.
But be careful who you trust—some things don’t stay human for long.
